blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Tuesday questioned Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon’s clarification that no Taguig project was among the 10 “conclusive” ghost projects identified nationwide, saying the secretary should stand by his earlier statement that there were no ghost projects in the city. In a Facebook livestream, Cayetano questioned Dizon’s explanation that his earlier statement before the Senate finance subcommittee referred to the 10 projects that had been conclusively identified as ghost projects nationwide, none of which was in Taguig.
